name: Scars of Summer: After
storyline: Keita and Ryoka have lived in the small village of Iriki for years as best friends who spend every summer vacation having fun together. In this sequel to the original game, you can go back and experience your last normal summer together, a year before the summer that changed everything, and then experience that summer all over again.
summary:
Live out your last two summers with your childhood friend and attempt to save her from the many fates that await her in the backwards village where she grew up. Explore a rural Japanese town, enjoying various activities either alone or with Ryoka. Through fun minigames, try bug-catching, watermelon-splitting, martial arts, part-time jobs, and collecting all the prizes from an old-timey gacha machine.

Keita doesn't have much influence, but he can call Ryoka while she's on her own to chat about what she's doing, or seek her out to talk in person. It's up to you to decide how to stay connected!
